in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सहस्र (thousand) + अर्विद् (knowledge) + या (she) = thousand-knowledge-she = goddess of knowledge with a thousand petals.

in_marathi.name: Madhumita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Honey, Sweet Nectar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madhumita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Madhumita is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘madhu’, which means honey or nectar. In Hindu mythology, the goddess of love, Saraswati, is often depicted as having a neck adorned with a string of precious gems called ‘madhumalas’ or ‘sweet garlands’. The name Madhumita is thus a beautiful tribute to the sweetness and beauty of the divine. It is also said to symbolize the sweetness of life and the love and compassion that we extend towards others.
